reason_for_supersession: Pre-outcome audit found that the first receipt mislabeled S+I sufficiency as compactness, allowed a bridge label without requiring a conditional bridge contribution, and scanned 44 high-order terms for any large interaction. The exact 16-corner design is unchanged; the estimands are corrected before execution.
novelty: Exact 16-corner within-game causal factorial over subject (S), first post-subject token (I), remaining bridge (B), and attractor phrase (A) source values under recipient scores. It tests S+I sufficiency, conditional bridge repair, and the named S-by-I interaction without searching over interaction terms.
required_computation: evaluate every one of 16 subsets simultaneously from the same captured native and donor values
define the game as v(T)=mean_margin(T)-mean_margin(empty) and normalize by v(full)
verify every subset reconstructs from its Möbius dividends and sum Shapley equals v(full) within 1e-8
report CE only as supporting evidence
required_controls: full subset reproduces the atlas joint-all-values arm row by row
complete-head arm reproduces the atlas complete-head arm row by row
groups are a disjoint exhaustive partition of positions 1 through final; source 0 stays native
native recipient/donor capability and complete-head direction are live in every cell

registered_within_game_screens.SI_sufficient: v(SI)/v(full) is at least 0.70 in every cell
registered_within_game_screens.bridge_repairs_failed_SI: in every cell below the SI bar, v(SIB)/v(full) is at least 0.80 and [v(SIB)-v(SI)]/v(full) is at least 0.10 with positive conditional CE benefit
registered_within_game_screens.named_SxI_interaction: the SxI Möbius dividend has absolute magnitude at least 0.10 of v(full), a common sign across cells, and that sign in both deterministic lexical halves of every cell

descriptive_only: S+I Shapley share and joint addition to B+A for necessity/redundancy context
interpretation_limits: The 0.70 and 0.80 thresholds were chosen after seeing singleton results on these reused TEST rows; outcomes are within-game characterization, not confirmation.
S+I sufficiency does not establish compactness or necessity.
Möbius dividends describe downstream task nonadditivity under this intervention family, not ontology labels.
Future unseen nouns/constructions are required before claiming a stable circuit decomposition.
